description:
HushThreads v0.0.4 has 10 patches for Threads 449.0.0.54.82 (com.instagram.barcelona). New in this release are Open links in browser, Disable video autoplay, Block background-return feed refresh and Hide suggested users. Sanitize sharing links now hands out the post's own link in place of Threads' short share link. The others are Hide ads, Disable analytics, Remove the advertising ID, Restore screens on re-signed builds and HushThreads settings.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 448 runtime tests passed locally. All 156 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 10 patches applied to Threads 449.0.0.54.82 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 449.0.0.54.82, version code 511908382. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
